page.overview:
Who is Fukuemon?

Fukuemon is an owl with brown feathers on its head and back while the stomach area has white feathers. He has large orange-coloured eyes with black pupils and has two blue markings on his chest area.

Motoi uses him to send messages from Genbu to Kumogakure.

In Naruto Mobile and Naruto: Ultimate Ninja Online, Fukuemon assists Motoi in battle during gameplay. He attacks the enemy with wings on the fly, and also has impressive strength, lifting an adult shinobi into the air and dropping him into a pre-prepared trap.
